'''Durmuş Ali Demir''' (March 10, 1967 – February 24, 2024) was a [[Turkish people|Turkish]] theoretical physicist. He worked at [[Sabancı University]] between 2019-2024. He was a dean of the Graduate School of Engineering and Sciences<ref>{{cite web | url=http://enstitu.iyte.edu.tr/main_eng.jsp?pageName=about_graduate_school.htm | title=The Graduate School of Engineering and Sciences- IYTE | access-date=2011-01-01 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110815175803/http://enstitu.iyte.edu.tr/main_eng.jsp?pageName=about_graduate_school.htm | archive-date=2011-08-15 }}</ref> at the [[Izmir Institute of Technology]] where he was the ex-chair of the Physics Department.<ref>{{cite web | title=Durmuş Ali Demir (Ex-Chairperson) | url=http://www.iyte.edu.tr/physics/people/durmusalidemir.html | publisher=Izmir Institute of Technology | access-date=2009-04-21 | archive-url=https://archive.today/20120802191056/http://www.iyte.edu.tr/physics/people/durmusalidemir.html | archive-date=2012-08-02 }}</ref> His research areas include [[supersymmetric standard model]], [[extra dimensions]] and [[general relativity]].

==Awards==
* 2009 Full Member, [[TWAS]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://twas.ictp.it/mbrs/members-elected-2009|title=Full Member|publisher=TWAS|access-date=2010-01-02|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101204125756/http://twas.ictp.it/mbrs/members-elected-2009|archive-date=2010-12-04}}</ref>
* 2006 [[The Humboldt Prize]] (Alexander von Humboldt Foundation Prize)<ref>{{cite web | url=http://www.tuba.gov.tr/haber.php?id=119 | title=Alexander von Humboldt prize awarded to Professor Durmus Ali Demir|publisher=TUBA (Turkish Academy of Science)|access-date=2009-04-22}}</ref>
* 2005 [[Scientific and Technological Research Council of Turkey|TÜBITAK]] Young Scientist Prize
* 2004 [[Turkish Academy of Sciences|TÜBA]] Young Scientist Prize
* 2001 TGC [[Sedat Simavi]] Science Award<ref name=TUBA>{{cite web|url=http://www.tuba.gov.tr/index.php?id=218 |title=TUBA - Prof. Dr. Durmuş Ali Demir |access-date=2009-05-01 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100925064256/http://www.tuba.gov.tr/index.php?id=218 |archive-date=September 25, 2010 }}</ref>
* 1997 [[Parlar Foundation Science Award|METU Parlar Foundation Encouragement Award]]<ref name=TUBA />
